name: Ananya
roles: matriarch of the Aravali Yurt Sanctuary
notes: An assistant archivist at the Narmada Academic Library in middle Epoch 4, who saved six centuries of deep-time survey charts on the day the ground broke. A roof beam on the Night of Red Teeth took her memory of the old world entirely; she kept the twins, the hearth and her grief, and the homestead she opened to wanderers became the Aravali Yurt Sanctuary. Decades later, white-haired, she met Varuna and Mithra at the shrine and remembered none of it. One of the Founding Three, and the one who lived.
